assignments.name: Assign_Restricted_True
assignments.label: Assign Restricted True
assignments.description: Sets varHasRestrictedGD to TRUE and jumps straight to Decide_Fulfillment_Value (skipping remaining loop iterations). Any single GDD whose restriction type is not "Without Donor Restriction" is sufficient to force Conditional; no need to keep iterating.

assignments.name: Assign_Fulfillment_Conditional
assignments.label: Assign Fulfillment Conditional
assignments.description: Sets the target FulfillmentType to Conditional. Reached when the current GC has any child GDD whose FQS_Restriction_Type__c is not "Without Donor Restriction" (Purpose, Permanent, or Earned Revenue) OR any populated FQS_Restriction_Release_Date__c on the GC.

assignments.name: Assign_Fulfillment_Unconditional
assignments.label: Assign Fulfillment Unconditional
assignments.description: Sets the target FulfillmentType to Unconditional. Reached only when every child GDD is "Without Donor Restriction" AND FQS_Restriction_Release_Date__c is blank.

assignments.name: Fault_Silent_Exit
assignments.label: Fault Silent Exit
assignments.description: Terminal sink for all fault paths in this subflow. Intentional silent exit: FulfillmentType is a low-stakes categorization, so a mid-flight GC delete, a validation-rule collision on the write-back, or an FLS block should NOT throw and cancel the triggering record's save. The next legitimate trigger event on the GC or any child GDD will re-attempt the recalc. Identity no-op with no outgoing connector, so the interview terminates gracefully. If silent failure ever becomes hard to diagnose, replace this sink with a Platform Event publish or a custom-object log — do NOT let faults bubble.

decisions.name: Decide_GC_Loaded
decisions.label: Decide GC Loaded
decisions.description: Short-circuit guard: Get_GC uses assignNullValuesIfNoRecordsFound=true, so a mid-flight GC delete (or a bogus id) returns a hollow record with Id=null. Bail via Fault_Silent_Exit before touching Get_GDDs or the loop, otherwise the subsequent SOQL fires against a null bind and either faults or silently returns nothing.

decisions.name: Decide_Is_Excluded
decisions.label: Decide Is Excluded
decisions.description: Per-iteration exclusion: skip the current GDD if excludeGDDId is set AND matches this row's Id. Set only by the BeforeDelete caller. The blank guard is critical — without it, Flow's EqualTo on a blank rightValue can silently match every row, causing the loop to skip all GDDs and the recalc to always return Unconditional.

decisions.name: Decide_Restricted_GDD
decisions.label: Decide Restricted GDD
decisions.description: Per-iteration check: if the current GDD's restriction type is anything OTHER than "Without Donor Restriction" (i.e., Purpose, Permanent, or Earned Revenue), jump to Assign_Restricted_True and exit the loop. Only truly unrestricted GDDs fall through — every other classification carries strings attached and forces Conditional.

decisions.name: Decide_Fulfillment_Value
decisions.label: Decide Fulfillment Value
decisions.description: OR rule: target Conditional if varHasRestrictedGD is TRUE (any child GDD's FQS_Restriction_Type__c is not "Without Donor Restriction" — i.e., Purpose, Permanent, or Earned Revenue) OR the GC's FQS_Restriction_Release_Date__c is populated (any date, past or future — the pledge remains conditional as long as a release-date restriction is on the record). Otherwise Unconditional.

decisions.name: Decide_Needs_Write
decisions.label: Decide Needs Write
decisions.description: Idempotency guard: only fires the record update if the target value differs from the GC's current FulfillmentType. Prevents recursive re-triggering of the GC AfterSave flow when this subflow writes back.

Flow.description:
Fundraising Quick Start: shared subflow that recomputes GiftCommitment.FulfillmentType. Invoked by GC AfterSave (release-date changes), GDD AfterSave, and GDD BeforeDelete.
Rule (OR): FulfillmentType = 'Conditional' if ANY child GDD (ParentRecordId = giftCommitmentId) has FQS_Restriction_Type__c NOT equal to 'Without Donor Restriction' (i.e., Purpose, Permanent, or Earned Revenue — anything with strings attached) OR the GC's FQS_Restriction_Release_Date__c is populated (any date). Otherwise 'Unconditional'.
Release-date semantics: the presence of a release-date restriction — not its future-ness — determines Conditional. A pledge with a past release date is still a pledge that was made under a time restriction; it flips to Unconditional only when the date is cleared or the restricted designations are removed.
Idempotent: reads the GC's current FulfillmentType and skips DML if the target value matches, so re-invocation is safe and cannot recurse.
Flow.label: FQS Recalculate GC FulfillmentType

loops.name: Loop_GDDs
loops.label: Loop GDDs
loops.description: Iterates child GDDs looking for any restriction type other than "Without Donor Restriction". Exits early via Assign_Restricted_True the moment one is found (Assign_Restricted_True routes to Decide_Fulfillment_Value, not back to the loop). Each iteration first passes through Decide_Is_Excluded so BeforeDelete callers can skip the row being deleted.

recordLookups.name: Get_GC
recordLookups.label: Get GC
recordLookups.description: Loads the GiftCommitment identified by the input giftCommitmentId. Reads the current FulfillmentType (for the idempotency guard) and FQS_Restriction_Release_Date__c (for the release-date branch of the Conditional rule). assignNullValuesIfNoRecordsFound=true so a mid-flight GC delete (or a bogus id) short-circuits at Decide_GC_Loaded rather than throwing.

recordLookups.name: Get_GDDs
recordLookups.label: Get GDDs
recordLookups.description: Retrieves all child GiftDefaultDesignation records whose ParentRecordId is the target GC. Uses the GDD.FQS_Restriction_Type__c formula (mirrors parent GD's restriction type) to avoid a second lookup on GiftDesignation. Any excludeGDDId filtering happens per-iteration in the loop (Decide_Is_Excluded), not in this SOQL — keeps the query bind Id-shape agnostic.

recordUpdates.name: Update_GC_Fulfillment
recordUpdates.label: Update GC Fulfillment
recordUpdates.description: Writes the computed FulfillmentType back to the GC. Fires only when the target differs from the current value (see Decide_Needs_Write). Fault path routes to Fault_Silent_Exit so a validation-rule collision or FLS block on the write-back never cancels the triggering record's save — the next legitimate trigger will re-attempt.

variables.description: Optional. When set (only by the BeforeDelete caller), the GDD with this Id is skipped inside the loop so the about-to-be-deleted row does not skew the recalc. Default blank — no live GDD Id equals blank, so all rows are kept for non-delete callers.
variables.name: excludeGDDId
